purpose: Technical preview for a 24-direction pre-rendered player with denser turns and separate body and weapon layers.
camera: strict orthographic camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees; character rotates only around the world vertical axis
facing: 24 evenly spaced azimuth directions; frame zero faces screen-right
lighting: controlled cyan rim with restrained magenta bounce; stable opaque material across every sampled direction
prompt: Create a technical game-character preview board preserving the approved compact armored player identity. Show twelve evenly sampled views from a 24-direction pre-rendered system under one strict 45-degree top-down orthographic camera, emphasizing smoother silhouette changes around diagonals. Include body-only, weapon-only, and correctly socketed composite demonstrations. The rifle shares the camera and rig, is held naturally with both hands, and uses proper front/behind occlusion. Tactical graphic illustration, no labels or text.
revision_prompt: Preserve the sheet and change only the isolated weapon strip: each rifle must use the same strict 45-degree orthographic projection and corresponding yaw as the assembled player views, with stable grip and muzzle sockets.
negative_constraints: no floating, orbiting, or yo-yo weapon
no translucent body or per-view brightness drift
no identity, armor, proportion, or lighting drift
no text, border artifacts, cropped anatomy, or extra characters

references.role: identity consistency reference; old camera is not authoritative
